versions.changelog: Preserve display name for deterministic config refresh release
Add deterministic GitHub PR config refresh helper
Remove pr-ship reference from report template (fully generic)

v2.0.0: Add --auto-resolve flag for automatic conflict resolution via AI subagents. Add orchestrator/worker execution model. Add persistent conflict escalation (3+ cycles). Add postSyncHooks for repo-specific post-sync actions. Improve report templates.
Add seamless detection of reopened PRs in update-config: auto-restores from droppedPatches/closedWithoutMerge and promotes from localPatches back to openPRs. New report section for reopened PRs.
Declare Git and GitHub CLI (gh) as required dependencies
Removed direct build execution - skill now only reminds user to rebuild. Reduced security surface: no arbitrary command execution, only git and gh CLI operations.
Added security notice documenting filesystem/network access and build execution requirements
Initial release: manage forks with open PRs, sync upstream, rebase branches, track PR status, build production branches, review closed PRs, manage local patches
